purpose: Explicit ledger of skill identities found during enumeration that are not promoted to canonical records because Xenoverse 2-specific class/subcategory evidence is insufficient or conflicting.
rules: Do not invent class/subcategory, Ki cost, acquisition, DLC, CaC availability, or Ultimate Finish requirements.
A gap may be promoted only after Xenoverse 2-specific evidence establishes the required field(s).
Historical or cross-game evidence is retained as corroboration, not treated as current Xenoverse 2 proof.

gaps.name: Acid
gaps.known_identity: Cast-exclusive Super used by Saibaman variants
evidence: Xenoverse 2 character ID list identifies Acid as CaC-unavailable
Xenoverse 2 PQ evidence identifies Kyukonman/Kaiwareman as users
gaps.reason: Current dedicated searches did not establish the Xenoverse 2 attack/subcategory fields strongly enough.

gaps.name: Howl
gaps.known_identity: Great Ape-exclusive skill used by Great Ape enemies
evidence: Great Ape Festival and related PQ enemy tables list Howl for Great Ape Nappa, Vegeta, Bardock and Baby
gaps.reason: Identity and cast restriction are established, but a reliable Xenoverse 2 skill page establishing its canonical class/subcategory was not located.

gaps.name: Boiling Burg
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Legend Patrol enemy table lists Boiling Burg on Final Form Demigra
gaps.reason: Older Xenoverse documentation describes Boiling Burg as an Ultimate, but that is not sufficient by itself to establish the current Xenoverse 2 canonical subtype.

gaps.name: Energy Boil
evidence: Xenoverse 2 Legend Patrol enemy table lists Energy Boil on Final Form Demigra
gaps.reason: Current Xenoverse 2-specific subtype evidence was not located.

gaps.name: Baked Sphere
evidence: Xenoverse 2 PQ enemy tables list Baked Sphere for villainous characters
Dragon Ball technique documentation describes its Xenoverse lineage
gaps.reason: Cross-game descriptions disagree with or do not explicitly establish the current Xenoverse 2 canonical class/subcategory, so it remains a gap rather than a guessed record.

notes: Saibabeam was intentionally excluded from this ledger because Batch 294 established its research record. Boiling Ball and Tricky Strike were likewise covered in Batch 289.
